SK8

PlayStation style — STAGED. Real 3D, Tony Hawk camera behind the skater, a jointed character rig built from Bigg's avatar, and Gemini art on the world and the board. Same frozen game underneath: same tricks, same scoring, same street layout the sim drives.

ARENA — the stage. Skate the street forward through four neighborhoods, survive the falls, and ride through the gate at the end of the street into the skatepark, where play opens up Tony Hawk style. The street is the gate; the park is the payoff.

YOUR LIKENESS — tap any picture below to enlarge it. Front, side, and back views prove the full likeness — curly hair, goatee, gold chain front — that the rear follow camera alone can never show. In game the back of the shirt carries the real PHANTOMDREAMSZ seal, big and centered; the front stays plain white.

HOW TO PLAY SK8

The game PAUSES while this is open. Press GOT IT (or PAUSE again) to resume exactly where you left off.

Arena: four neighborhoods on the street (Maplewood, Downtown, Arts District, Beachfront), 4–5 recorded fall gestures on bails, and the skatepark after the finish gate — free steering there with LEFT / RIGHT / FWD / BACK (arrows or W A S D work too), EXIT PARK returns to the start screen. Park tricks add to a separate PARK SCORE only — street scoring and the frozen trace never change.

Sound & narration (manifest, no audio files yet): street/city ambience, board roll, trick pop, landing, grind scrape, and bail sounds are wired as trigger points but stay silent until real lines and sounds are recorded — no beeps stand in for them. Passers-by speak only now and then (never continuous commentary), shown as subtitles, with the NARRATION button to mute them.

  • Buttons — OLLIE (bottom left), FLIP (bottom right), GRIND (bottom right, hold). OLLIE jumps. FLIP spins the board mid-air. GRIND only counts while you are HOLDING it — lift your thumb and the grind stops on the very next tick. Nothing is latched.
  • Keyboard — Space = ollie, F or K = flip, hold G = grind, P or Esc = pause (pause menu has EXIT PARK).
  • Score — tricks x flow multiplier. Chain grows only on obstacle-linked tricks (car ollie, gap clear, stair ollie, grind exit, linked kickflip), up to x4. Flat ollies/flips score but never grow the chain. 3 bails ends the run; 600m finishes it.
  • Grind (+5 every tick, +15 clean exit). Hold GRIND when you reach a rail. Sparks fly while you grind.
  • Cars, gaps, stairs. Ollie the cars, clear the gaps while airborne, drop the stairs. Grounded into a car or a gap is a bail.

PAUSED

The street is frozen. Resume to continue exactly where you left off.
